task.property_text: QuerySet.values() and values_list() on a JSONField never put a caller-supplied key into SQL unquoted.

property_clause.property: QuerySet.values() and values_list() on a JSONField never put a caller-supplied key into SQL unquoted.

environment.scope: The django/django library as built from this repository, imported fresh in a forked child. Only sbc_world may drive it.
harness: Tests run as `python /verifier/run.py <your test path>` from /work, the repository root, in an offline sandbox. A verifier-owned pytest fixture named `sbc_world` is available to every test. Do not define a fixture with that name, do not add a conftest.py, and do not read or write anything under /verifier. Do not import the library under test yourself; drive it only through `sbc_world`. The verdict does not depend on your test's assertions: the verifier records what the library actually did and decides from that record.

sbc_world.values_sql(key) and sbc_world.values_list_sql(key) compile a values or values_list selection for one JSONField key, importing django fresh. sbc_world.filter_sql(key) compiles a filter for that key. The verifier records an injection only when a caller-supplied key reaches the SQL text unquoted. A test that shows the failure composes values_sql() or values_list_sql().
